about.en: BELIEVE is the token associated with Believe, Ben Pasternak's Solana platform for launching tokens from social posts. It is the SPL token at BLVxek8YMXUQhcKmMvrFTrzh5FXg8ec88Crp6otEaCMf, distinct from the earlier Launch Coin (LAUNCHCOIN) mint Ey59PH7Z4BFU4HjyKnyMdWt5GGN76KazTAwQihoUXRnk and from unrelated tokens using the BELIEVE ticker.
